reconfigure.title: Update this controller
reconfigure.description: Rename this controller or replace its API token. Use a replacement token for the same controller to preserve its Home Assistant entities.

reauth_confirm.title: Replace Microclimate API token
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the replacement token for this same controller. Existing entities and customizations will be preserved.

error.required: Enter the controller name and API token.
error.invalid_auth: The API token was rejected. Check the token and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to validate the controller connection. Try again later.
error.already_configured: This API token is already used by another controller entry.

abort.already_configured: This API token is already configured.

init.title: Microclimate controls and diagnostics
init.description: Configuration controls are editable by default. Disable writes here to keep observations only. Full response logging remains separately off by default; enable it with Home Assistant DEBUG logging for troubleshooting. Credentials are redacted but controller names and readings remain visible.

data.enable_writes: Enable configuration writes (on by default for this release)

writes_disabled.message: Configuration writes are disabled in integration options.

unsupported_capability.message: This setting is unavailable for this channel, timing mode or response.

stale_context.message: The controller mode or encoding changed. Refresh the setting and try again.

invalid_number.message: Enter a finite number between 0 and 100 inclusive.

invalid_date.message: Enter a valid DD/MM date. Leap day and unset dates are not accepted.

invalid_time.message: Enter a manual time from 00:00:00 to 23:59:59 without fractional seconds or a timezone.

invalid_option.message: Select one of the supported configuration options.

unsupported_encoding.message: No consistent supported controller time encoding is available for this field.

rejected.message: The server rejected the update. The observed configuration is retained.

rate_limited.message: The server rate limited the update. Check the observed value before trying again.

mismatch.message: The requested setting was not confirmed by API readback. The observed value is displayed.

uncertain.message: The update outcome is uncertain. Check the controller and observed value before trying again.

invalid_auth.message: The controller token was rejected. Reauthenticate the integration.

read_failed.message: A fresh baseline could not be obtained. No update was sent.

invalid_season_order.message: Season starts must be distinct and follow season 1–4 through one yearly cycle. Only one December/January crossing is allowed.

season_dates_unavailable.message: Cannot validate season order: another season date is missing or invalid. Correct it on the controller and refresh first. Explicit 00/00 dates are treated as unset.

invalid_ramp.message: Enter a whole number of minutes between 0 and 240 inclusive.

control_denied.message: Schedule control permission is unavailable or was revoked. No further update was sent.
